column1: # job_failure_policy.tsv -- the ONE table that says which scheduled-job failures are already explained.
# Read-only data for the overnight email (send_overnight_self_review_email.R via
# .claude/scripts/lib/job_failure_lib.R); no script writes it. Pattern: scanner_policy.tsv.
# job          plist label of the failing job
# cause_regex  POSIX ERE matched against the cause line taken from the job's logs,
#              or exit:<n> to match the job's raw exit code
# class        known | self-heal | human. known and self-heal are shown as one line with the
#              issue link and are NOT counted as failed. human stays in the email headline.
# issue        issue number (digits) or empty
# note         one line: why this happens
# A job or cause that is not listed is human. An empty, missing or unparseable table is
# INDETERMINATE in the email; it never makes anything known.
# Adding a row may merge automatically (Tier 2 class state-table, auto_merge_state_tables.txt);
# deleting or editing a row, and any other change, stays Class C: it decides what the owner is NOT told about.
